scenarios.name: Hero Section Value Proposition Display
scenarios.description: Verify that the hero section displays product name, tagline, and value proposition prominently above the fold, allowing users to understand MirDB's purpose within 3 seconds of page load

steps.description: Load the MirDB homepage in a browser
steps.context: User lands on the homepage from search, referral, or direct link

steps.description: Check that the hero section is visible above the fold without scrolling
steps.context: Standard viewport size (1920x1080 desktop, 375x667 mobile)

steps.description: Confirm presence of product logo/name, tagline, and value proposition text
steps.context: Expected tagline: 'Persistent Key-Value Store with Memcached Compatibility'

steps.description: Verify that the persistence advantage is clearly communicated without scrolling
steps.context: User should understand MirDB's key differentiator immediately

test_cases.input: Load homepage and inspect hero section DOM elements
test_cases.expected: Hero section contains h1 with 'MirDB' product name, tagline text mentioning 'Persistent' and 'Memcached', and 2-3 sentence value proposition

test_cases.expected: All hero content is fully visible within initial viewport (no scroll required)

test_cases.input: Check semantic HTML structure of hero section
test_cases.expected: Hero uses semantic HTML with proper heading hierarchy (h1 for product name)
